turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: I've been thinking a lot about our conversations and I wanted to ask, have you considered setting any long-term financial goals for yourself? Are you saving for anything in particular, like a big purchase or a long-term investment?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I've been meaning to get around to planning for a bigger project, actually. I've been eyeing a new travel trailer for our next adventure. Nothing too extravagant, just a cozy little home on wheels for some weekend getaways.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: That sounds like a great idea, a travel trailer can be a lot of fun. Can you tell me a little bit more about your current budget for this project, do you have a specific price range in mind for the trailer and any other expenses that might come with it?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I've been doing some research and I've got a rough idea of what I'm looking at, but I don't want to commit to a specific number just yet. I'd say I'm thinking in the range of $30,000 to $50,000, depending on the features and amenities I want.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: That's a good range to have in mind. Have you also thought about how you plan to finance this purchase, will you be paying cash or looking into financing options?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I think I'll just use a portion of my retirement savings to cover the cost of the trailer, and then I'll need to find a place to park it. I've got a small plot of land that I've been considering for a few years now, and I'm hoping to work out a deal with the landowner to make it a regular spot for my trailer.
